confidence_notes: Holistic estimates with wide uncertainty, especially for accommodation because Montego Bay has a strong resort market and limited hostel stock. Cocktail and wine estimates use their typical price relationship to restaurant beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Broadly based on Jamaican resort-city pricing, with Negril and Ocho Rios as directional comparables; Montego Bay's airport and resort demand can raise tourist-facing prices.
